optimization_notes: optimized.py: the intermediate variables s, p, o go; the loop body is one g.add with the three terms inlined, in the same evaluation order. Nothing else to compress.

optimized.ldpy, from optimized.py: one `+{ }` with `f<{binding['s']['value']}>` and `f<{binding['p']['value']}>` for the URIRef calls (no @base in scope) and an interpolation of json_to_term(...), which always returns an RDF term.

Exception to the symmetry, island-only: `@graph as g` replaces `g = Graph()` and `@graph g`. No prefix is in scope, so the runtime gives a plain rdflib Graph with its own namespace manager (the cached shared manager is attached only when prefixes are in scope), and the function does not bind anything on it.
